title: Daily digest: Build globally competitive firms from Te | Health Minister lays out plan for intern | NIA’s anti-terror conference discusses c | Trump defends Putin relationship, warns
headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
bullets_en: Build globally competitive firms from Telangana, IT Minister urges entrepreneurs.
Health Minister lays out plan for international medical tourism in State hospitals.
NIA’s anti-terror conference discusses cross-border terrorism, threat from drones.
Trump defends Putin relationship, warns AI data centres must stay in US.
bullets_ur: IT Minister ne entrepreneurs ko Telangana se aalami sathi par muqabla karne wali firms bananay par zor diya.
Health Minister ne soobai hospitalon mein bain-ul-aqwami medical tourism ka mansooba pesh kar diya.
NIA ki anti-terror conference mein sarhad paar dehshatgardi aur drones ke khatraat par guftagu hui.
Trump ka Putin se taalluqat ka defa, AI data centres US mein hi rakhne ki tanbiya.
